name: SEEW Television Championship
epitaph: Defended on the fed's own last card (12 July 1997), where champion Polecat retained by double-disqualification against Killer Kenny before vacating the title in a post-match promo to pursue a Heavyweight Championship match instead.

name: SEEW Heavyweight Championship
epitaph: Named in commentary during the fed's own last card (12 July 1997) as the stakes of a match between Mike 'the Mechanic' Malone and Polecat that the surviving record does not carry; no bestowal is recorded.
